title: Smash and Grab
question: How did Mr. Taylor try to stop the thieves?

meanings.meaning: 砸橱窗抢劫（指砸碎商店橱窗盗窃商品的行为）
meanings.usage: 复合名词，常用来描述针对商铺的快速抢劫行为

meanings.meaning: 拱廊；（两侧设有商店的）拱廊街道
meanings.usage: 指有拱顶的通道，两侧通常开设商铺
不可数名词，统指各类珠宝首饰，美式英语常写作jewelry
后面可接名词或代词作宾语，常用搭配admire sb./sth.
可表示整理物品，也可表示安排活动、行程等
不可数名词，指质地柔软的丝绒面料
强调长时间目不转睛地看，常用搭配gaze at sth./sb.

meanings.meaning: （喇叭、音乐等）发出响亮而刺耳的声音
meanings.usage: 常用来描述噪音大的声响，主语多为horn、speaker等
可表示车辆高速行驶发出的轰鸣声，也可表示动物的咆哮
指用猛力将物体砸碎，常用搭配smash sth. with sth.
可指劫匪的抢劫行动，也可指警方的突击搜查
强调动作匆忙、慌乱，常用搭配scramble into/out of sth.

meanings.meaning: 极好的；难以置信的；极大的
meanings.usage: 可形容速度、数量等非常惊人，也可表达对事物的夸赞
可数名词，由ash（烟灰）和tray（托盘）复合构成
指人物或动物的雕塑作品

phrases.usage: 表示车辆、机器等逐渐停下，强调停止的过程，比stop更具画面感

examples.en: The bus came to a stop just in time to avoid hitting the child.
examples.zh: 公交车及时停了下来，避免撞到那个孩子。

examples.en: The engine sputtered and finally came to a stop.
examples.zh: 引擎噼啪响了几声，最终停了下来。

phrases.usage: 指擅自取用、偷窃，也可礼貌邀请别人随意取用食物、物品等

examples.en: The intruder helped himself to all the cash in the safe.
examples.zh: 闯入者偷走了保险箱里所有的现金。

examples.en: Please help yourself to some drinks if you are thirsty.
examples.zh: 如果你渴了请随便喝点饮料。

phrases.usage: 形容速度极快，相当于at an extremely high speed

examples.en: The sports car drove past at a fantastic speed.
examples.zh: 跑车以极快的速度开了过去。

examples.en: The project is progressing at a fantastic speed.
examples.zh: 这个项目正以惊人的速度推进。

phrases.usage: 表示偷了某物后成功逃脱，也可表示做了坏事却没有受到惩罚

examples.en: The burglars got away with jewellery worth over £100,000.
examples.zh: 窃贼偷走了价值10万多英镑的珠宝，逃之夭夭。

examples.en: Don't think you can get away with lying to me.
examples.zh: 别以为你对我撒谎能蒙混过关。

phrases.usage: with的独立主格结构，用来描述伴随状态，结构为with + 宾语 + 宾补（形容词/副词/介词短语等）

examples.en: He stood in the rain, with his clothes completely wet.
examples.zh: 他站在雨里，衣服全湿了。

examples.en: She left the office, with the lights still on.
examples.zh: 她离开了办公室，灯还亮着。

phrases.usage: 表示“价值……的东西”，结构为“金额/时间 + worth of + 名词”

examples.en: The storm caused thousands of pounds worth of damage.
examples.zh: 风暴造成了价值数千英镑的损失。

examples.en: I bought two weeks' worth of food before the holiday.
examples.zh: 放假前我买了够吃两周的食物。

phrases.usage: 表示留在驾驶座上开车，wheel此处指代汽车的方向盘

examples.en: You stay at the wheel while I go into the shop to buy some water.
examples.zh: 我去商店买水的时候你留在车里开车。

examples.en: He stayed at the wheel for 6 hours before stopping to rest.
examples.zh: 他连续开了6小时车才停下来休息。

sentences.en: The expensive shops in a famous arcade near Piccadilly were just opening.
sentences.zh: 靠近皮卡迪利大街的著名拱形建筑里的那些高档商店刚刚开门。

sentences.en: At this time of the morning, the arcade was almost empty.
sentences.zh: 在早晨这个时候，拱形建筑里几乎空无一人。

sentences.en: Mr. Taylor, the owner of a jewellery shop was admiring a new window display.
sentences.zh: 珠宝店店主泰勒先生正在欣赏新布置的橱窗。

sentences.en: Two of his assistants had been working busily since 8 o'clock and had only just finished.
sentences.zh: 他的两名助手从8点钟就开始忙碌，刚刚才把橱窗布置好。

sentences.en: Diamond necklaces and rings had been beautifully arranged on a background of black velvet.
sentences.zh: 钻石项链和戒指精美地摆放在黑色丝绒的衬托下。

sentences.en: After gazing at the display for several minutes, Mr. Taylor went back into his shop.
sentences.zh: 泰勒先生凝视橱窗几分钟之后，便回到了店里。

sentences.en: The silence was suddenly broken when a large car, with its headlights on and its horn blaring, roared down the arcade.
sentences.zh: 正在这时，突然一辆开着车灯、鸣着喇叭的汽车，咆哮着冲进了拱形建筑，打破了寂静。

sentences.en: It came to a stop outside the jeweller's.
sentences.zh: 它在珠宝店门口停了下来。

sentences.en: One man stayed at the wheel while two others with black stockings over their faces jumped out and smashed the window of the shop with iron bars.
sentences.zh: 一个人留在驾驶座上，另外两个人则蒙着黑色丝袜跳下车，用铁棍砸碎了商店的橱窗。

sentences.en: While this was going on, Mr. Taylor was upstairs.
sentences.zh: 就在这当儿，泰勒先生正在楼上。

sentences.en: He and his staff began throwing furniture out of the window.
sentences.zh: 他和店员开始把家具往窗外扔。

sentences.en: Chairs and tables went flying into the arcade.
sentences.zh: 椅子和桌子飞进了拱形建筑。

sentences.en: One of the thieves was struck by a heavy statue,
sentences.zh: 其中一个窃贼被一尊沉重的塑像砸中，

sentences.en: but he was too busy helping himself to diamonds to notice any pain.
sentences.zh: 但他只顾忙着抢钻石，根本没注意到疼痛。

sentences.en: The raid was all over in three minutes, for the men scrambled back into the car and it moved off at a fantastic speed.
sentences.zh: 抢劫在3分钟之内便结束了，因为劫匪们又争先恐后地跳上汽车，汽车以惊人的速度开走了。

sentences.en: Mr.Taylor rushed out and ran after it throwing ashtrays and vases,
sentences.zh: 泰勒先生冲了出来，一边追赶汽车，一边扔烟灰缸和花瓶，

sentences.en: but it was impossible to stop the thieves.
They had got away with thousands of pounds worth of diamonds.
sentences.zh: 他们已带着价值数千英镑的钻石逃走了。

exercises.prompt: “打碎；猛烈撞击” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: smash · /smæʃ/ · verb · 打碎；猛烈撞击。指用猛力将物体砸碎，常用搭配smash sth. with sth.

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：天鹅绒；丝绒
exercises.explain: velvet · /ˈvelvɪt/ · noun · 天鹅绒；丝绒。不可数名词，指质地柔软的丝绒面料

exercises.prompt: 补全短语：The storm caused thousands of pounds _____ damage.
exercises.hint: 风暴造成了价值数千英镑的损失。
exercises.explain: worth of：表示“价值……的东西”，结构为“金额/时间 + worth of + 名词”（风暴造成了价值数千英镑的损失。）

exercises.explain: The expensive shops in a famous arcade near Piccadilly were just opening. — 靠近皮卡迪利大街的著名拱形建筑里的那些高档商店刚刚开门。

source.en: The expensive shops in a famous arcade near Piccadilly were just opening.

exercises.prompt: “while表示“当……的时候”，引导时间状语从句时，通常强调主从句的动作在过去同一时间段同时发生” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: While + 从句（过去进行时）, 主句（过去进行时/一般过去时）
options: while引导的时间状语从句（过去进行时搭配）
exercises.explain: while引导的时间状语从句（过去进行时搭配）：While + 从句（过去进行时）, 主句（过去进行时/一般过去时）：从句的动作通常是延续性的，主从句动作同时发生时，延续性动作用过去进行时，短暂性动作用一般过去时

选出下面句子的正确中文意思：

grammar.title: 过去完成进行时
grammar.definition: 表示过去某个时间之前一直持续进行的动作，强调动作的持续性和连贯性，动作可能刚结束，也可能还在进行
grammar.structure: had been + 动词现在分词（doing）
grammar.usage: 常和since+时间点、for+时间段等时间状语连用，描述在过去某个动作发生前已经持续了一段时间的动作

examples.en: Two of his assistants had been working busily since 8 o'clock and had only just finished.
examples.zh: 他的两个助手从8点就一直在忙，刚刚才做完。

examples.en: I had been waiting for the bus for half an hour when it finally arrived.
examples.zh: 我已经等了半小时公交车，它才终于来。

examples.en: He had been studying English for three years before he went abroad.
examples.zh: 他出国前已经学了三年英语。

grammar.title: while引导的时间状语从句（过去进行时搭配）
grammar.definition: while表示“当……的时候”，引导时间状语从句时，通常强调主从句的动作在过去同一时间段同时发生
grammar.structure: While + 从句（过去进行时）, 主句（过去进行时/一般过去时）
grammar.usage: 从句的动作通常是延续性的，主从句动作同时发生时，延续性动作用过去进行时，短暂性动作用一般过去时

examples.en: While this was going on, Mr. Taylor was upstairs.
examples.zh: 当这一切发生的时候，泰勒先生在楼上。

examples.en: While I was cooking dinner, my husband was watching TV.
examples.zh: 我做晚饭的时候，我丈夫在看电视。

examples.en: While we were walking in the park, it began to rain.
examples.zh: 我们在公园散步的时候，开始下雨了。

patterns.pattern: The silence was suddenly broken when + 事件

original.en: The silence was suddenly broken when a large car, with its headlights on and its horn blaring, roared down the arcade.
original.zh: 宁静突然被打破，一辆大轿车亮着前灯，响着喇叭，呼啸着冲进了拱廊街。

examples.en: The silence was suddenly broken when a fire alarm went off in the building.
examples.zh: 大楼里的火警突然响起，打破了宁静。

examples.en: The silence was suddenly broken when a child started crying loudly in the library.
examples.zh: 一个孩子在图书馆里大声哭了起来，宁静突然被打破。

patterns.pattern: Just as + 某事正在发生, 主语 + 动作

original.en: Just as it was leaving, Mr.Taylor rushed out and ran after it throwing ashtrays and vases.
original.zh: 就在轿车离开的时候，泰勒先生冲了出来，跟在后面追赶，一边扔烟灰缸和花瓶。

examples.en: Just as the train was leaving, she arrived at the station out of breath.
examples.zh: 就在火车要开的时候，她气喘吁吁地赶到了车站。

examples.en: Just as I was taking a photo of the sunset, my phone died.
examples.zh: 就在我要拍日落的时候，我的手机没电了。

original.en: The raid was all over in three minutes, for the men scrambled back into the car and it moved off at a fantastic speed.
original.zh: 抢劫行动总共只用了3分钟，因为那些人争先恐后地爬回车里，然后以极快的速度开走了。

examples.en: We decided to cancel the picnic, for the weather forecast said it would rain heavily.
examples.zh: 我们决定取消野餐，因为天气预报说会下大雨。

examples.en: He didn't attend the meeting, for he had caught a bad cold the day before.
examples.zh: 他没有参加会议，因为前一天他得了重感冒。
